$comment: Every factual or comparative sentence in the essay on /thesis/, with its source. Held to the page by tests/thesis-contract.test.mjs: every sentence in the essay that carries a number has an entry, and every entry's match is printed on the page. Refreshing a checkedAt date is a reviewed action.
